result.description: Velarune's Lumen Arcadia is a fictional ambient lighting fixture designed for quiet reading corners and display shelves. It features a matte ceramic base, a dimmable warm-to-cool LED module, and touch-sensitive brightness control. The lamp is intended for indoor decorative use, offering stable tabletop placement, low power consumption, and a soft diffuse glow rather than task-grade illumination.
result.title: Lumen Arcadia Nebula Desk Lamp
result.title_description: Decorative dimmable desk lamp with ceramic base and integrated LED lighting
